reviews.text: Excellent service and amazing food. Feeling the real "Rio de la Plata" flavour. Thanks Catalina and rest of the team.

(Translated by Google) We ordered the Neapolitan-style breaded cutlets and they were incredible. The staff was very friendly. Next time we'll go for the barbecue. (Original) Pedimos milanesas napolitanas y estuvieron increibles. El personal muy amable. La proxima iremos por el asado.
I've never eaten such a nice and tender lamb stake before. The cooking was perfect.
The experience was 10/10, we where received by Cande the manager, the food was delicious, it transport me back to Argentina. Highly recommended!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
